The evidence

THE QUESTION

What can we actually measure?

How does English Wikipedia article attention change around GTA VI announcements and release, and how does its release window compare with selected historical games? The signal is pageviews—not sales, unique people, sentiment, or players.

OBSERVATIONS1,649Initial snapshot · 11 Nov 2026
HISTORICAL TARGETS135Three releases · retrospective
PASSING TESTS79Python + JavaScript
PAID APIS0No API key or inference

THE SYSTEM

Reproducibility is the product.

01

Preserve the input.

A Python/curl collector saves exact Wikimedia responses and checksummed acquisition receipts. Invalid dates, dimensions, duplicates, and incomplete windows cannot silently replace valid data.

02

Fix the rules.

Historical comparisons use the same release-relative windows. Forecasts use only preceding observations. Missing baselines stay unavailable; future GTA VI values stay null.

03

Verify the output.

The browser checks payload hashes and matching source/analysis IDs before display. CI tests Python 3.11 and 3.13, while manual refresh produces an isolated candidate rather than silently deploying.

THE RESULTS

A useful baseline can be simple.

Yesterday's count beat a trailing-week mean on full-window MAE across all three historical tests. Equal-game WAPE was 17.0% versus 32.4%; these are error ratios, not accuracy scores. The weekly mean did better during GTA V's three-day re-release window, which remains in the report.

GTA VI's article views rose 67.3% between the two complete seven-day windows ending November 10, 2026. Its fixed index baseline was only 20/21 days complete, so the indexed curve was withheld rather than changing the rule to force a result.

Three selected historical windows do not establish generalization. Event-window associations do not establish causation. No prospective GTA VI forecast is claimed.

THE FAILURE THAT HELPED

“Works locally” wasn’t enough.

The first CI matrix reproduced the analysis on Python 3.13 but failed on 3.11. Changes in floating-point accumulation produced tiny error-total differences. Accurate summation fixed the replay across both versions, while preserving earlier snapshots and leaving the displayed findings byte-identical.

The site remains a saved snapshot with no scheduled refresh. Exact article titles can miss earlier titles and redirects. GTA V's comparison is a 2022 console re-release, not its 2013 original launch.
